name: mission terminal
description: A wall-bolted electric terminal with a cyan screen and a slot for credit chits.  Fixers post jobs here.  Examine it to browse contracts.

name: shopping terminal
description: A mains-powered vending terminal with a glowing price list.  Examine it to buy goods with yen.
A fist-sized black core wrapped in a ribbon of warning tape.  Somebody paid a lot to get this back.

name: cash machine
description: A steel cash machine with a green display and a worn keypad.  Examine it to use your bank account.

effect.u_message: [Bank] Balance: <global_val:trl_bank> yen.  Cash on hand: yen in your pack.

then.u_message: [Trilobit] The terminal could not locate a safe site.  Try another contract.
[Trilobit] Contract complete.  1500 yen paid, and your standing improves.

description: A data core has been hidden in a building in this district; the terminal's map marker shows the area.  Find it and pick it up.

effect.u_message: You have the core.  Return to the mission terminal.

name.str: Retrieval (2/2): return the core to the terminal

description: Bring the data core back to whoever gave you the contract (the mission terminal or a faction contact).  Paid on delivery.
A target is holed up in a building in this district.  Go there and identify him.

effect.u_message: You are close.  The target should be in here.

description: The target is somewhere in this building.  Kill him.

effect.u_message: The target is dead.  Return to the mission terminal.

description: Return to whoever gave you the contract (the mission terminal or a faction contact).  Paid on completion.
Watch the subject from at least 10 tiles away for 10 turns without being seen by them.  Staying out of their line of sight and moving behind them helps.

effect.u_message: Observation complete.  Return to the mission terminal.

description: Return to whoever gave you the contract (the mission terminal or a faction contact).  Paid on completion.

then.u_message: [Trilobit] The subject spotted you.  Observation reset.

dynamic_line.yes: &MISSION TERMINAL.  Three contracts are open.  Choose one.  Payment on completion: 1000 yen.
dynamic_line.no: &MISSION TERMINAL.  You already hold an open contract.  Check your mission log, report a finished one, or abandon it here.

responses.text: [Retrieval] Recover a data core and bring it back.
[Assassination] Find a target, kill him, report back.
[Spying] Watch a subject from 10+ tiles for 10 turns unseen.

dynamic_line: &CONTRACT ACCEPTED.  Details are in your mission log.  When the objective is done, return and speak to this terminal to report and be paid.
&CONTRACT ABANDONED.  No payment.  The terminal accepts new contracts.
